objectives.statement: Distinguish state with være from change with bli.
Distinguish possession with ha from receiving or getting with få.
Recognize common helping-verb uses of bli, ha, and få.
Build and correct sentences using the four verbs in context.

notes: Must contrast state, change/become, possession, receiving/getting, and auxiliary-like uses. Include common learner traps such as bli + adjective and få + noun/infinitive.
